summary: A generic schema-3 grader installs a frozen offline Python graph in its owned lease, preserves source imports and the original verifier/scorer, and checks a complete read-only dependency inventory after grading. Schema-2 tasks keep their existing profile.

research.scope: Reviewed pip hash mode requires hashes for all dependencies and exact pinned requirements; native installs use the complete frozen graph and no index.

retained_diagnostic_failures.cause: Control bound stdout bytes instead of the validated baseline manifest
Windows Path formatted the guest interpreter with backslashes
Restored project scratch area and the image home were read-only

corrections: Bind the validated manifest file exactly
Represent guest protocol paths with PurePosixPath and retain a cross-platform regression test
Provide disposable project write access and a private bounded task home; retain an unprivileged native write preflight
limitations: The original selected DICOM task still lacks a passing task-specific success control and Windows subject qualification.
No candidate skill was modified after selected task or evaluator exposure. The task remains exposed public development data.
The fixed cohort remains 12 tasks and 36 planned matched attempts. Model launch remains gated.
No model benchmark, meaningful model improvement, original-environment equivalence or commercial readiness is established.
